about.heading: About IPScope
about.tagline: IPv4 address visibility and reservation tracking for Unraid Docker networks.
about.description: IPScope helps you understand which IPv4 addresses are occupied, reserved, excluded, or available across your Docker networks. It combines live container data with saved Unraid template reservations and highlights conflicting address claims.
about.feature_inventory: IPv4 inventory grouped by Docker network
about.feature_ownership: Runtime container ownership and stopped-container reservations
about.feature_conflicts: Duplicate and mismatched address conflict detection
about.feature_suggestions: Available IP suggestions with snapshot freshness protection
about.safety_description: IPScope is read-only. It does not change Docker networks, containers, or Unraid templates. An available suggestion means no known conflict was found; it is not a guarantee that an address is unused by DHCP clients, offline devices, or hosts outside Docker.
about.author: Maintainer
dhcp.heading: DHCP allocation settings
dhcp.description: Describe the DHCP service for each Docker network. IPScope does not connect to or modify your router.
dhcp.pools_help: Addresses inside these ranges are excluded from fixed-IP suggestions.
dhcp.reservations_help: Reserved addresses are excluded even when they are outside the dynamic pool.
dhcp.safety_description: Unknown DHCP status is treated conservatively: IPScope will not label addresses as safe suggestions until you configure the pool or confirm DHCP is disabled.
dhcp.label: Device / note
lan_scan.heading: Active LAN address scan
lan_scan.description: Probe explicitly selected IPv4 addresses on a local interface. A missing ARP reply does not prove an address is available.
lan_scan.targets_help: Enter one IPv4 address per line, or separate addresses with commas. Up to 256 targets; targets must belong to the selected interface subnet.
lan_scan.safety_description: Only the addresses you enter are probed. The scan does not change router, DHCP, Docker, or host configuration. No response is an unknown result, not proof that an IP is free.
lan_scan.validation: Enter an interface and between 1 and 256 target addresses.
lan_scan.invalid_ip: One or more target values are not valid IPv4 address strings.
lan_scan.no_interfaces_help: No active IPv4 interface with a scannable subnet was found.
